title: descendants of David and Solomon

questions.question: Where were David’s first six sons born?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 3:1 (ESV): "These are the sons of David who were born to him in Hebron..."

questions.question: Who was David’s second son?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 3:1 (ESV): "...the second, Daniel, by Abigail the Carmelite..."

questions.question: How long did David reign in Hebron?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 3:4 (ESV): "He reigned there seven years and six months..."

questions.question: Who was the father of Rehoboam?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 3:10 (ESV): "The son of Solomon was Rehoboam..."

questions.question: Who was the last king of Judah listed in the genealogy before the exile details?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 3:15 (ESV): "The sons of Josiah... the fourth Zedekiah."

questions.question: How many sons were born to David in Jerusalem?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 3:5-9 (ESV): Mentions four by Bath-shua plus nine others listed in verses 6-8.

questions.question: Who was the daughter of David mentioned?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 3:9 (ESV): "...besides the sons of the concubines, and Tamar was their sister."

questions.question: Who was taking into captivity?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 3:17 (ESV): "The sons of Jeconiah, the captive..."

questions.question: Who was the father of Zerubbabel?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 3:19 (ESV): "The sons of Pedaiah: Zerubbabel and Shimei..." Note: Ezra 3:2 calls him son of Shealtiel, but 1 Chronicles says Pedaiah.

questions.question: Who was the mother of Solomon, Shimea, Shobab, and Nathan?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 3:5 (ESV): "...four by Bath-shua, the daughter of Ammiel."

questions.question: Who was the firstborn of Josiah?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 3:15 (ESV): "The sons of Josiah: Johanan the firstborn..."

questions.question: Who were the sons of Zerubbabel?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 3:19 (ESV): "...The sons of Zerubbabel: Meshullam and Hananiah..."

questions.question: Who was the sister of Meshullam and Hananiah?
How many sons did Elioenai have?
Who was the father of Shealtiel?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 3:17 (ESV): "The sons of Jeconiah, the captive: Shealtiel his son..."

key_verse_text: The son of Solomon was Rehoboam, Abijah his son, Asa his son, Jehoshaphat his son...
